summary: Frontend-only verification of the new student marketing content on the public web pages (/ and /pricing). All 4 acceptance criteria pass. Homepage renders the 'home-student-usecase' section with heading 'Built for how students actually work.', all three cards (Study together, Compare AI models, Student price), and a working 'home-student-cta' button that navigates to /pricing. Homepage pricing teaser now shows exactly 5 plans in the correct order: Free, Student ($6.99/mo, 2,500 credits/month), Pro, Team (MOST POPULAR), Enterprise. /pricing lists the Student card with $6.99/month monthly and $69/year annual (with .edu verification messaging). No layout or console errors introduced by this change.
critical_code_review_comments: Public pages (/ and /pricing) emit one benign 401 in the browser console (from an unrelated /api/auth/me or similar identity probe fired on anonymous marketing pages). Not caused by this change and does not affect rendering, but consider suppressing the identity probe on public routes to keep the console clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Homepage student use-case section + 5-plan pricing teaser and /pricing student card (monthly $6.99, annual $69) verified via Playwright at desktop viewport 1920x4000. Backend not tested (per request). Test-IDs used: home-student-usecase, home-student-cta, pricing-toggle-annual.
